Subject MRACHKOVSKY - information re

Made by D. S. Mischenko Forwarded by Ja. Pitts. DS.

Information has been received to the effect that a Russian
named MRACHKOVSKY in the employ of Nanking Government, arrived
in Shanghai from Nanking by train on August 12, 1937.
The purpose of his visit is to engage Russian military
experts for service in the Chinese Army. It will be recalled
that MRACHKOVSKY was a prominent figure in recruiting Russians
during the hostilities in 1932. Unconfirmed information
indicates that he is now living at 226 Route Vallon French Con-
cession, but further enquiries are proceeding.

V. Moschenko
D. S.

事由 关于 MRACHKOVSKY 的情报

由 D. S. Mischenko 制作，经 Ja. Pitts. DS. 转呈。

接获情报称，一名受雇于南京政府的俄国人 MRACHKOVSKY 于1937年8月12日乘火车从南京抵达上海。
他此行的目的是为在中国军队中服役而招募俄国军事专家。值得回顾的是，MRACHKOVSKY 在1932年战事期间曾是招募俄国人的重要人物。未经证实的情报显示，他目前居住在法租界华伦路（Route Vallon）226号，但进一步的查询正在进行中。

Subject MRACHKOVSKY- Employee of the Chinese Government- activities of.

Made by D.S. Mischenko. Forwarded by Ja Pitts - 55

With reference to the contents of a report dated
August 13, 1937 I have to report that a Russian named MRACHKOVSKY
in the employ of Nanking Government, is residing at 559D, Rue
Lafayette, French Concession.
MRACHKOVSKY has been interviewed and he states that
his visit to Shanghai is not for the purpose of recruiting
Russian experts for the Chinese Army.
Further visits were paid to MRACHKOVSKY at divers
times and dates by 'unemployed Russians', in order to ascertain
the present activities of this man, but up to the present no
confirmation can be obtained that he is recruiting for the
Chinese Army.

V. Mischenko.
D. S.

事由 MRACHKOVSKY - 中国政府雇员 - 其活动情况。

由 D.S. Mischenko 制作。经 Ja Pitts - 55 转呈

鉴于1937年8月13日报告的内容，兹报告如下：一名受雇于南京政府的俄国人 MRACHKOVSKY 现居住于法租界拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）559D号。
已对 MRACHKOVSKY 进行问话，他声称其访问上海的目的并非为中国军队招募俄国专家。
此后，“失业俄国人”在不同时间和日期多次拜访 MRACHKOVSKY，以查明此人的当前活动，但截至目前，尚未获得确证表明他正在为中国军队进行招募。

V. Mischenko.
D. S.

Subject (in full) Russians in the service of the Chinese Army.

Made by D.S. Makeroff. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached translation from the French
Intelligence report of March 1932, I have to state that during
the month of February 1932, about sixty Russians, all ex-military
men, comprising artillery and machine-gun experts were engaged in
Shanghai by the Chinese military authorities for service against
the Japanese.

A number of these individuals were brought from
Nanking while the others were recruited locally.

It appears that a certain Captain Mrachkovsky, former artillery
officer of the Russian Army, who for the past four years has held
the post of artillery instructor in the Nanking Government,
arrived in Shanghai following the outbreak of hostilities. After
residing with his family at No. 24 Rue Massenet until Feb. 12, he
proceeded to Chapei taking with him six Russian machine-gun and
artillery experts.

Captain Mrachkovsky who had received the rank
of General, was placed in charge of two armoured trains which
operated from the Markham Road junction.

The armament of these trains consisted of four 75 mm. "Arisaka"
guns, two anti-aircraft 'Gruson' 57 mm. guns and eight Vickers
machine-guns. The gun crews of the armoured trains consisted
entirely of Russians. For their services it is reported that they
received a daily wage of $40.00 in respect of machine-guners and
$60.00 for artillery men.

also
The Chinese Airforce is said to have engaged a number of Russians
as machine-guners. For this work they receive a wage of $100.00
per day when flying. A number of Germans and Americans are repo-
rted to have been engaged as pilots, for which they are said to
be paid $500.00 per day. Half of the amount is paid prior to the

事由（全称）在中国军队中服役的俄国人。

由 D.S. Makeroff 制作。经 [签名] 转呈

参照附上的1932年3月法国情报报告译文，本人须陈述如下：在1932年2月期间，约有六十名俄国人，均为前军人，包括炮兵和机枪专家，被中国军事当局在上海雇用，以对抗日军。

其中一些人是从南京带来的，其他人则是在本地招募的。

据悉，某位 Mrachkovsky 上尉，前俄国陆军炮兵军官，过去四年一直担任南京政府的炮兵教官，在战事爆发后抵达上海。他与家人在马思南路（Rue Massenet）24号居住至2月12日，随后前往闸北，随行带有六名俄国机枪和炮兵专家。

Mrachkovsky 上尉已被授予将军军衔，负责指挥两列装甲列车，这些列车从马克姆路（Markham Road） junction 出发行动。

这些列车的武器装备包括四门75毫米“有坂”（Arisaka）火炮，两门57毫米“格鲁森”（Gruson）高射炮和八挺维克斯（Vickers）机枪。装甲列车的炮手全部由俄国人组成。据报道，他们的服务报酬为机枪手每日40.00美元，炮兵每日60.00美元。

此外
据说中国空军也雇用了一些俄国人作为机枪手。从事此项工作时，他们在飞行期间的日薪为100.00美元。据报道，一些德国人和美国人被雇用为飞行员，据说他们的日薪为500.00美元。一半金额在

It is reported that no less than 300 foreigners comprising
Russians, Germans and Americans were engaged in various branches
of the Chinese Army while operating in the environs of Shanghai,
chiefly as artillery, machine-gun and aviation instructors.
Among those engaged include the following:-
1) Liskoff. Former artillery non-commissioned officer in the
Russian Army; Has been appointed Lieutenant-Colonel.
2) Glumoff. Former machine-gun officer in the Russian Army;
Has been appointed Captain.
3) Bashladin. (Tartar) interpreter; speaks several Chinese dialects
fluently; Holds the rank of Lieutenant-Colonel.
4) Kuklin. Former machine-gun officer in a cavalry regiment of
the Russian Army; Holds the rank of General.
Kuklin and a number of other Russians are reported to have been
wounded but efforts to locate their present whereabouts have so
far been unsuccessful.
Regarding the last paragraph on the attached report of March 1,
the Japanese Military Headquarters state that they have no
information concerning the capture and subsequent execution of
12 Russians, East of Tsang, on February 28.

TRANSLATION OF ITEMS OF INTEREST FROM FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE REPORT
DATED MARCH1, 1932.

Russians in the service of the Chinese Army.
According to information at our disposal, the Commandant
of the 19th Route Army has held conferences, these last few
days, with several former Russian officers af on the subject
of the organization of a group of Russian specialists (Machine-
gunners, artillerymen etc.,) in the service of the Chinese
Army, operating in the Shanghai region.
The following took part in these conferences: Chinese :
General Gaston W'NG, Chief of Staff of the 19th Route Army, and
M.WANG-JE-P NG, former Head of the Political Department of the
Chinese Police in Harbin; Russian : Colonel KOVALEVSKY (who
speaks Chinese fluently) and Colonel KHEIEVSKY (former officer
of the Shnghung army of Marshall CH NG-CHUNG-CHANG). The
rendez-vous'took place at:
1. No. 1331 Sinza Road - Statistic Bureau of Chinese Taxes,
where is also installed the Information Service of th
Headquarters of the 19th Army.
2. No. 518-520 Avenue Road.
3. No. 16 Avenuè Joffre (home of WING-JE-P NG)
The conferences did not lead to anything, as the Russian
representatives demanded a large sum in advance to commence
the enrollment. Despite the failure of these conferences, some
40 Russians are already enrolled in the Service of the Chinese
Army, and some, between themselves, took part in the latter
fights against the Japanese,
During the course of the battle East of Tazang, on February
28, 12 Russians, amongst whom were several machine-gunners, were
made prisoners by the Japanese. They were shot by the latter.

1932年3月1日法国警察情报报告中感兴趣项目的译文。

在中国军队中服役的俄国人。
根据我们要掌握的情报，第十九路军司令近日与几位前俄国军官举行了会议，主题是组织一群在中国军队中服役、在上海地区行动的俄国专家（机枪手、炮兵等）。
参加这些会议的有以下人员：中方：第十九路军参谋长 Gaston W'NG 将军，以及前哈尔滨中国警察政治部主任 M.WANG-JE-P NG；俄方：KOVALEVSKY 上校（流利掌握中文）和 KHEIEVSKY 上校（前张作霖元帅奉军军官）。会面地点在：
1. 新闸路1331号 - 中国税务统计局，第十九军总部情报处也设在此处。
2. 爱文义路（Avenue Road）518-520号。
3. 霞飞路（Avenuè Joffre）16号（WING-JE-P NG 住所）
会议未达成任何结果，因为俄国代表要求预付一大笔款项才开始招募。尽管这些会议失败，但已有约40名俄国人受雇于中国军队，其中一些人自行参与了后来对日军的战斗。
在2月28日曹家渡（Tazang）以东的战斗过程中，12名俄国人，其中包括几名机枪手，被日军俘虏。他们随后被日军枪决。

Commissioner of Police.

Sir,

Information.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Information from French Police.
Armoured trains on the Shanghai-Nanking line.

We are informed that there are three armoured trains now
on the Shanghai-Nanking line.

These trains are armed as follows:

2 "Arisaka" guns 76m.m.
4 Anti-aircraft guns 57m.m
8 "Maxim-Vickers" machine guns (Chinese manufacture) of
which 2 are anti-aircraft guns.
Three groups of small armed locomotives (Draisines)
are in the course of being made at Pukow.
Each group will have four (draisines) armed with two
guns of 57 m.m. and four machine guns.

As soon as their armaments are completed these locomotives
will be put on the Shanghai-Nanking Railway Line.

Subject (in full) General G. Boutlin.
Made by Det. Maklansky. Forwarded by Tho Rubertson supt.
Information has been received to the effect that
General G. Boutlin of the White Russian General Staff,
who formerly was Assistant War Minister of Admiral
Kolchak's Siberian Government in Omsk in 1918 to 1919,
has received an appointment from the Minister of War
of the National Government. His position is that of
Instructor in the Chinese Academy of the General Military
Staff in Nanking. He is being paid a salary of $400 per
month. General G. Boutlin left Shanghai for Nanking
a few days ago.
B. Maklansky.
D. S.

REPORT
File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Foreign Station,
No. I. O. U. 1338
Date June 30 1930.
Subject (in full) Recruitment of White Russians for the National Army.
Made by D.S. Maklaevsky. Forwarded by H.P. Robertson Supt.
Sir,
Information has been received from a very reliable source
to the effect that General Ying, attached to the Air Force
of the National Government, arrived in Shanghai from Nanking
during May of this year. He rents room No. 214 at the Great
China Hotel, Thibet Road, but is not residing there at present.
He resides in the Chinese territory at his brother's house,
and is at present sick. General Ying who is very familiar
with the Russian Language is sometimes known under the name
of Vassily Petrovich Ying. He was in Soviet Russia for two
years, where he served in Red Army. He graduated from a
Soviet Avio School and later was in the Air Force of Marshal
Feng Yu-hsiang's Army. In 1926 he deserted from Marshal Feng
Yu-hsiang's Army and joined Marshal Chang Tsung Chang, who
placed him in charge of the Air Force Unit. In 1928 after the
fall of Marshal Chang Tsung Chang he turned over to the
National Army, where he is at present serving in the Air Force
Department. He was sent to Shanghai by Marshal Chiang Kai-shek
to recruit White Russian officers who are specialists in
aviation.
According to General Ying he expects in the near future
the arrival in Shanghai of 20 new planes of different makes,
ordered by the National Government from the U.S.A.
The following Russian officers and men have been invited
by General Ying to serve with pay at $500 per month:-
Mr. Bakin- Russian Military Pilot. Employed
by the China Airways Inc.
Mr. Andreichuk- Russian Military Pilot. At present
in Mukden.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
档案号
上海公共租界工部局警务处
外侨巡捕房，
第 I. O. U. 1338 号
日期 1930年6月30日。
主题（全称）为国民革命军招募白俄人员。
由 D.S. Maklaevsky 撰写。由警司 H.P. Robertson 转呈。
先生：
据非常可靠的消息来源获悉，
隶属于国民政府空军的应将军（General Ying）于今年五月从南京抵达上海。他在西藏路的大中华大酒店租用214号房间，但目前并未居住于此。他现居华界其兄家中，且目前患病。应将军精通俄语，有时也被称为瓦西里·彼得罗维奇·应（Vassily Petrovich Ying）。他曾在苏维埃俄国逗留两年，期间在红军服役。他毕业于苏联航空学校，后来在冯玉祥元帅军队的空军中任职。1926年，他从冯玉祥元帅军队开小差，投奔张宗昌元帅，张宗昌任命他负责空军部队。1928年张宗昌元帅垮台后，他转投国民革命军，目前在空军部门服役。他是受蒋介石元帅派遣来上海招募精通航空技术的白俄军官的。
据应将军称，预计在不久的将来，将有20架不同型号的新飞机运抵上海，这些飞机是国民政府向美国订购的。
以下俄国军官和士兵已受到应将军邀请，以每月500美元的薪金服役：-
巴金先生（Mr. Bakin）- 俄国军用飞行员。受雇于中国航空公司（China Airways Inc.）。
安德烈丘克先生（Mr. Andreichuk）- 俄国军用飞行员。目前在沈阳。

June 7, 30.
White Russian officers serving in the National Army.

The following Russian officers are at present serving
in the National Army:-
1) General Krachkovsky- Senior Instructor. Salary $600
per month. His headquarters
are at 53 Se Tiao Hsiang
Chung Hsin Fan Tien, Nanking.
2) Colonel Kolpinsky- Instructor in Artillery. Salary
$120 per month. In Nanking.
3) General, Name unknown-, Instructor Engineer. Salary
$120 per month. In Nanking.
4) Captain Koteloff- Machine gun Instructor. Salary
$200 per month. In Hankow.
5) Lieut-Colonel Nikolaeff- Infantry Instructor. Salary
$120 per month. In Hankow.

The following Russian officers are attached to the
National Army on active service:-
6) Colonel Kukkin-. Cavalry Instructor. Salary
$150 per month.
7) Colonel Fedoseeff- Cavalry Instructor, Salary
$120 per month
8) Captain Sergienko- Technical Instructor. Salary
$120 per month.

9) Iyakoff, Sergeant, &
10) Sergeeff, Sergeant- Both serving as Chinese Sergeant
Instructors.
11) Gleumoff Sergeant- Recently was captured prisoner
of war by Marshal Feng Yu-hsiang's
troops. Was executed by order
of Marshal Feng Yu-hsiang.

4) 科特洛夫上尉（Captain Koteloff）- 机枪教官。月薪200美元。在汉口。
5) 尼古拉耶夫中校（Lieut-Colonel Nikolaeff）- 步兵教官。月薪120美元。在汉口。

以下俄国军官隶属国民革命军现役：-
6) 库金上校（Colonel Kukkin）- 骑兵教官。月薪150美元。
7) 费多谢耶夫上校（Colonel Fedoseeff）- 骑兵教官，月薪120美元
8) 谢尔吉延科上尉（Captain Sergienko）- 技术教官。月薪120美元。
